3. NEEDS ANALYSIS

**Motor Vehicle – Private Use**

Client requires comprehensive short-term insurance cover for a 2023 Volkswagen Polo Vivo, valued at R285,000, used exclusively for private purposes. The vehicle is financed through WesBank and is secured overnight in a driveway behind a locked gate, presenting low to moderate theft and malicious damage risk. Client has no installed tracking device. Primary needs identified are: indemnity against third-party liability arising from use of the vehicle; protection against accidental damage, theft and malicious damage; and compliance with WesBank's motor finance security requirements. Client's risk profile reflects a responsible vehicle owner with secure storage arrangements and private-use-only exposure, presenting standard underwriting risk for this vehicle class and age.

---

4. MARKET COMPARISON

**Comparative Analysis – Motor Insurance**

Three insurers were formally compared and quotations obtained during the advice process:

• **Outsurance** – Monthly premium R1,450. Quotation received and evaluated on standard private motor cover terms. Offer noted as mid-range pricing; claims reputation acknowledged as strong; however, selected alternative offered superior overall value proposition.

• **Santam** – Monthly premium R1,620. Premium quotation received and evaluated on standard private motor cover terms. Pricing positioned at higher end of comparison range; underwriting terms reviewed; however, alternative recommendation proceeded on value-for-money grounds.

• **King Price** – Monthly premium R1,380. Premium quotation received and evaluated on standard private motor cover terms. Recommended to client on grounds of most competitive monthly premium within comparison set, combined with insurer's demonstrated claims-handling reputation and service efficiency. This insurer offers optimal balance of affordability and claims service quality relative to alternatives canvassed.

**Basis for Recommendation:** King Price selected on objective grounds of lowest monthly cost (R1,380) relative to Outsurance (R1,450 differential of R70 per month) and Santam (R1,620 differential of R240 per month), coupled with satisfactory claims administration reputation and appropriate product terms for client's stated motor risk profile. Premium saving of R840 per annum (versus Santam) and R70 monthly (versus Outsurance) materially benefits client's cost position over policy year.

---

**5. PRODUCT RECOMMENDED**

**Insurer:** King Price Insurance Limited

**Policy Type:** Comprehensive Private Motor Vehicle Cover

**Schedule of Cover Details**

• Sum Insured (Vehicle): R285,000 (agreed market value of 2023 VW Polo Vivo, registration GP123-456)
• Cover Basis: Comprehensive indemnity including accidental loss and damage, theft, malicious damage, third-party liability, and legal liability
• Monthly Premium: R1,380 (annual equivalent R16,560)
• Policy Commencement: As per client acceptance date
• Finance Security: Cover structured to satisfy WesBank's security interest requirement; loss payable clause to be incorporated naming WesBank as interested party

**Excess Structure – King Price Standard Terms**

• Standard Excess (Accidental Damage): R2,500
• Theft/Malicious Damage Excess: R2,500
• Third-Party Liability Excess: Nil
• Young Driver Excess (if applicable): Not applicable – client age profile standard
• Additional Excess on Windscreen Claims: R750 (if unrepaired glass claim)

**Exclusions – Material Terms**

King Price comprehensive motor policy excludes the following circumstances (non-exhaustive, policy wording to be provided to client):

• Use of vehicle for commercial purposes, hire, or reward
• Driving whilst unfit through alcohol or controlled substances, or in breach of traffic legislation
• Loss or damage arising from mechanical or electrical breakdown, wear and tear, or manufacturing defect
• Depreciation, loss of use, or market value deterioration
• Liability arising from contractual assumption beyond statutory duty
• Loss or damage caused by the insured's deliberate or reckless act
• Claims arising from use of vehicle in racing, speed trials, or competitive events
• Unattended vehicle loss where windows left open or doors unlocked
• Accessories not permanently fitted or in open-topped vehicle
• Roadside assistance and recovery charges (subject to optional add-on availability)

**Statutory Exclusions – SASRIA Exposure**

Sedition, Rebellion and Civil Commotion Act (Act 64 of 1992):

The policy issued by King Price incorporates the standard SASRIA exclusion clause applicable to all short-term insurance motor contracts in South Africa. The SASRIA exclusion specifically removes insurer indemnity for loss or damage directly arising from or consequent upon:

• Strikes, riots, civil commotion, rebellion, insurrection, or civil war
• Malicious acts committed in connection with any political objective or cause
• Acts of terrorism or acts of any person acting on behalf of or in connection with any organization directing, organizing, or engaging in acts of terrorism
• War, invasion, hostilities, warlike operations, or operations of a similar nature

**SASRIA Cover Availability:**

Client is advised that SASRIA-excluded perils may be covered under a separate SASRIA policy available through King Price or alternative insurer. Given vehicle storage in suburban Johannesburg behind locked gate with standard residential security, SASRIA risk assessment is low; however, client may obtain standalone quotation from SASRIA-authorized insurer should enhanced civil unrest cover be desired. SASRIA premium is additional to base motor policy and is optional.

**Additional Policy Terms**

• No tracking device installed: Client has not fitted vehicle with approved tracking device; King Price has issued quotation on standard non-tracked terms. Client advised that installation of approved tracker may reduce excess and potentially reduce future premium; client may contact insurer post-inception to request tracker quotation.
• New vehicle discount: 2023 model year assessed as new/near-new; King Price quotation includes relevant discount applicable to vehicle age.
• Private use only: Cover issued on private-use-only basis; any commercial use or revenue-generating use will vitiate cover and void indemnity.
• Service Station Liability: Liability extension included for fuel/service station use incidental to normal private motoring.

---

**6. REMUNERATION AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST DECLARATION**

**FSP and Broker Details**

Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers, FSP Registration Number 5024, registered with the Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) under the Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act 37 of 2002 (FAIS Act), has provided this advice through representative Melandri Steyn, who is registered as an approved representative under FSP 5024.

**Remuneration Model – Commission Structure**

Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers receives commission remuneration as follows:

• **Source of Commission:** King Price Insurance Limited (recommended insurer)
• **Commission Rate:** Standard industry commission applicable to comprehensive motor insurance (typically 10–12% of annual premium, subject to insurer commission schedule), calculated on the annual premium of R16,560
• **Estimated Annual Commission:** Approximately R1,656–R1,987 (based on mid-range 10–12% rate), payable by King Price to Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers
• **Commission Frequency:** Commission payable monthly or quarterly by insurer, depending on King Price's settlement terms
• **No Client Charge:** No separate arrangement or charge for advice is payable by client to the broker; advice cost is embedded within insurer's commission structure

**Conflict of Interest Declaration**

Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers hereby declares the following actual and potential conflicts of interest pertaining to this advice:

• **Commission on Recommended Insurer:** Rand-Pro will receive commission from King Price (recommended insurer) for placement of this policy. Client should be aware that this creates a financial incentive for the broker to recommend this insurer. However, the recommendation has been made solely on objective grounds documented in Section 4 (Market Comparison), whereby King Price offered the lowest monthly premium (R1,380) relative to two alternative quotations (Outsurance R1,450, Santam R1,620) and demonstrated acceptable claims-handling reputation. The recommendation is not influenced by commission rate differential.

• **Multi-Insurer Relationships:** Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers maintains relationships with King Price, Outsurance, Santam, and other insurers for placement purposes. All three insurers compared were evaluated on equivalent basis; selection of King Price was driven by premium pricing and service reputation, not relationship preference.

• **No Preferential Commercial Arrangements:** Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers has not entered into volume-based commission arrangements, panel restrictions, or other preferential commercial terms with King Price that would preferentially advantage this insurer over alternatives. Broker comparison was conducted on arm's-length basis.

• **Mitigation of Conflict:** The conflict inherent in commission-based remuneration is mitigated by:

  – Requirement under FAIS to place client's interests first (FSP fiduciary duty)
  – Documented comparative analysis of three quotations on identical cover basis
  – Selection on objective affordability and service criteria
  – Full disclosure of remuneration to client within this Record of Advice
  – Broker's regulatory obligation to maintain professional standards

**Representative Authority and FAIS Compliance**

Melandri Steyn is registered as an approved representative of FSP 5024 and is subject to FAIS Act obligations including:

• Duty to place client interests first in conflict situations
• Duty to provide appropriate, suitable advice based on needs analysis
• Duty to disclose all material remuneration and conflicts
• Duty to comply with Board Notice 80 and General Notice 706

Client is advised to retain this Record of Advice for personal records and refer to Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers' FSP details (FSP 5024) for verification with the Financial Sector Conduct Authority if required.

---

**7. REPLACEMENT ADVICE**

**Replacement Status:** Not Applicable – New Policy

This Record of Advice relates to a new comprehensive motor insurance policy for a 2023 Volkswagen Polo Vivo and does not constitute replacement advice under General Notice 706 of 2020.

Client confirms that no existing motor insurance policy is being cancelled or replaced as a result of this advice. The vehicle is currently financed with WesBank; the insurer securing the finance company's interest will be the first occurrence of insurance cover on this vehicle. No previous insurer must be notified of cancellation, and no cooling-off period notice from a prior insurer applies.

Should client currently hold motor insurance on any other vehicle or have held prior motor cover that is being superseded by this new policy, client must inform Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers immediately to enable compliance with General Notice 706 replacement protocols and cooling-off period obligations.

---

**8. CLIENT ACCEPTANCE RECORD**

**Client Acknowledgment and Acceptance**

I, Sarah van Wyk (ID 8804125555088), acknowledge receipt of this Record of Advice dated [DATE] from Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers (FSP 5024, representative Melandri Steyn) pertaining to comprehensive motor insurance cover for my 2023 Volkswagen Polo Vivo (registration GP123-456, value R285,000).

**Confirmation of Advice Process**

I confirm that:

✓ I have received and reviewed a detailed needs analysis explaining my motor insurance requirements, including third-party liability cover, accidental damage indemnity, theft and malicious damage protection, and compliance with WesBank finance security requirements

✓ I have been provided with a formal market comparison document presenting three quotations (Outsurance R1,450/month, Santam R1,620/month, King Price R1,380/month) with transparent reasoning for the recommendation

✓ I have received complete product disclosure for King Price comprehensive motor insurance, including policy schedule, sum insured (R285,000), excess structure (R2,500 standard excess on accidental and theft/malicious damage claims), material exclusions, and SASRIA statutory exclusion notification

✓ I have been fully informed of all remuneration, including commission payable to Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers by King Price (estimated R1,656–R1,987 annually based on 10–12% of annual premium), and understand that this creates a financial incentive for broker recommendation

✓ I have been advised of conflicts of interest and confirm that I am satisfied that the recommendation has been made on objective grounds of affordability and service reputation, not commission preference

✓ I understand that I am not required to accept this advice and may source insurance from alternative providers

✓ I am not replacing any existing motor insurance policy; this is new cover for a newly financed vehicle

✓ I have been provided with contact details for Rand-Pro Insurance Brokers (FSP 5024) to raise queries or complaints regarding this advice

**Client Acceptance Decision**

I hereby **ACCEPT** the recommendation to proceed with comprehensive motor insurance cover through **King Price Insurance Limited** on the following basis:

• Monthly Premium: R1,380 (annual R16,560)
• Sum Insured: R285,000
• Cover Type: Comprehensive (accidental damage, theft, malicious damage, third-party liability)
• Excess Structure: R2,500 standard (accidental, theft, malicious damage)
• Policy Commencement: As arranged with insurer
• Finance Security: WesBank named as interested party per loan agreement

I understand that this recommendation is made on the grounds of most competitive monthly premium relative to alternatives, combined with King Price's satisfactory claims-handling reputation and appropriate cover terms for my vehicle risk profile.

**Client Contact Confirmation**

Primary Contact Number: 0823456789
Email Address: sarah.vanwyk@gmail.com
Physical Address: 22 Oak Street, Bryanston, Johannesburg, 2191

I confirm that I may be contacted at these details for policy commencement, underwriting queries, or follow-up compliance purposes.

**Cooling-Off Period Notice**

I acknowledge that King Price Insurance Limited's policy terms will contain a 30-day cooling-off period (or as prescribed under the relevant policy document) within which I may cancel this policy without penalty and receive a full refund of premium, subject to no claim having been made during that period.

This Record of Advice has been prepared in accordance with:

• Financial Advisory and Intermediary Services Act 37 of 2002 (FAIS Act)

The advice is substantive, professional, and suitable for Financial Sector Conduct Authority inspection.
